name: Somchai Boonchu
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karts. He spent countless hours tinkering with engines, driven by an insatiable curiosity to understand how things worked. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering and quickly found himself drawn to the world of racing. His early career involved data analysis for a smaller Formula team, but his aptitude for simulation became apparent. 

At Manthey Racing, Somchai is responsible for developing and maintaining the team's advanced simulator. He meticulously calibrates the system, ensuring it accurately reflects real-world conditions. He believes that a good simulator engineer should not only be technically adept but also have strong communication skills. He's known for his calm demeanor and ability to translate complex technical concepts into easily digestible information for the drivers. His colleagues know him for his ability to find inventive solutions under pressure.

Somchai is a dedicated team member. His loyalty stems from the belief that a cohesive environment is essential for success. He's always willing to go the extra mile to ensure that the simulation environment is optimized for performance. He is also a strong advocate for incorporating innovative techniques into the simulator program.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
